qa_pairs.question: What amperage rating does Fuse 27 have?
What amperage rating does Fuse 9 have?
When is Fuse 27 hot according to the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuse 27 is hot at all times.

qa_pairs.question: When is Fuse 9 hot according to the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuse 9 is hot in run or start.

qa_pairs.question: What wire color and gauge connects to connector C101?
qa_pairs.answer: A 1.5 GN/YL wire connects to connector C101.

qa_pairs.question: Which components are fed through connector S420?
qa_pairs.answer: S420 feeds the Amplifier (not used) and Board Computer Horn unit, both on page 6500-1.

qa_pairs.question: What is the evaporative purge valve relay connector number?
qa_pairs.answer: The evaporative purge valve relay uses connector 75.

qa_pairs.question: On which page can you find details for the Interior Light Timer Control unit?
qa_pairs.answer: The Interior Light Timer Control unit details are on page 6330-0.
